title: Metropolitan Cathedral of San Salvador
representedDate: Standing post-2011 cathedral, shown by the 2018 canonization exterior photographs and the present cathedral historical account.
geometryBasis: Exact mapped cathedral walls, facade with twin tower blocks, transverse wings and nave buttresses.
sectionBasis: Municipal heritage record gives 50 m tower and 45 m dome heights. The two Presidency originals show the principal arch, belfry rhythm, dome profile and nave windows. The University of El Salvador architectural study records the sheet-metal nave roof, concrete transept roofs, plain post-2011 finish, round side windows and paired drum openings.
limitations: Dome section, side openings, bell openings and secondary roof pitches beyond the two main viewpoints will be estimated from the named exterior sources and mapped perimeter.
The photographed nighttime illumination and event projections are temporary. Permanent exterior finishes are interpreted separately.
